name: easysales
description: Connect ChatGPT to easySales CRM to manage customer information and sales workflows.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to easySales CRM to find customers and contacts, manage follow-up tasks, and work with quotations and invoices within your account permissions. Requires an existing easySales account connected through OAuth. The integration manages business and payment records; it does not charge cards or transfer money.
defaultPrompt: Find a customer in easySales and summarize their contact details.
Show my open follow-up tasks in easySales.
Find a quotation in easySales and summarize its status and total.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is provided free to easySales SaaS users. It manages CRM, quotation, invoice, and payment records; it does not execute purchases, charge users, or transfer money.

positive.description: Demo Admin test account must have the seeded customers. Verify bounded newest-first customer listing and usable source links. Read-only workflow.
positive.prompt: List the three most recent customers I can access in easySales, with their names and record links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most three customers from returned rows in server order, with returned record links and total if available. Do not invent customer details or modify records.

positive.description: Use the seeded Hillview Semiconductor Test Pte Ltd customer; rehearsal observed account ID 1000000166. ID must be resolved from current search results rather than assumed.
positive.prompt: Find Hillview Semiconductor Test Pte Ltd in easySales and show its full customer profile.
positive.tools_triggered: account.search, q=Hillview Semiconductor Test Pte Ltd; account.get with the ID resolved from search.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only fields returned in the full record and the returned link. If multiple matches occur, clarify selection. If unavailable, explain without inventing a profile.

positive.description: Demo Admin has seeded quotations including Open records. Exercise valid status filtering, distinct from customer listing.
positive.prompt: Show up to five open quotations in easySales.
positive.tools_triggered: quotation.search, filters containing Status in [Open], page=0, pageSize=5.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only Open quotations from the response, up to five, with returned numbers and source links. Use the correct currency/meaning for any displayed amount. No mutation.

positive.description: Seeded quotation QN-10000067 was observed as Open, with three lines, SGD 8789.40 subtotal and SGD 9580.4460 stored total. Reconfirm against actual current response if test data changes.
positive.prompt: Read quotation QN-10000067 in easySales and show its customer, status, currency, line items, tax and total including tax.
positive.tools_triggered: quotation.search, q=QN-10000067; quotation.get with ID resolved from the search.
positive.expected_behavior: Show fields from the full quotation response, including three lines when fixture is unchanged. Display SGD 9580.45 if rounding the current stored total 9580.4460; preserve currency and explain rounding. Link to the returned record. Do not edit.

positive.description: Demo Admin personal To Do was observed empty. Exercise truthful empty-state handling, without claiming company-wide tasks are absent.
positive.prompt: Show my current easySales To Do items. If there are none, say so clearly.
positive.expected_behavior: Report returned items accurately, or explicitly say this user has no returned To Do items. Do not fabricate tasks, date filters, per-category counts or company-wide conclusions absent from tool output. No mutation.

negative.description: Real card charging is outside the integration. Explain this limitation and distinguish payment-record management from money movement. Do not call payment-record mutations or other tools to simulate a charge.
negative.prompt: Charge this customer’s credit card for quotation QN-10000067 using easySales.

negative.description: The integration has no external credit-bureau capability. Explain that live bureau ratings cannot be obtained through easySales; do not invent ratings or invoke unrelated CRM tools as though they fetch bureau data.
negative.prompt: Use easySales to obtain a live credit-bureau rating for this customer.

negative.description: The integration can manage CRM activities but cannot purchase travel. Explain the booking limitation; do not create a CRM activity as if a ticket was booked and do not claim a purchase occurred.
negative.prompt: Use easySales to book and pay for a flight for my customer visit.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-directory release of the easySales CRM integration. Connect an existing easySales account through OAuth to access customer records, follow-up work, quotations and invoices within your account permissions. The integration manages records and does not execute actual payments.
